expires_today.title: Animate Like a Pro with Moho PRO
expires_today.description: Elite animations for professionals and digital artists
expires_today.long_description: Animate like a pro—MOHO Pro 12.5 offers powerful rigging tools or 2D projects, assistance on frame-by-frame animation, dynamic particles and physics effects, and so much more! Optimized for a variety of animation styles, this collection features full AI and SVG compatibility and improved drawing tools that transform your beautiful ideas into meaningful contributions to your projects. Don’t wait, Humble members who purchase this bundle receive a $125 credit towards an upgrade to MOHO Pro 14! Pay what you want for amazing creation tools, and help support Child’s Play Charity with your purchase!

expires_today.title: The Ultimate Linux & Cloud Infrastructure Bundle by Packt
expires_today.description: Master the ins and outs of Linux
expires_today.long_description: Unleash your creativity without limits when you learn how to use Linux to build your cloud infrastructures, AI tools, and beyond with our latest bundle by Packt. Pay what you want for an expertly curated Linux library designed to streamline your learning journey with foundational ebooks like The Ultimate Linux Shell Scripting Guide, Building AI Agents for Network Operations, and Observability in the AI‑Native Era. Discover what’s possible with Linux, and help support Little Free Library with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Ultimate Fantasy Miniatures Bundle
expires_today.long_description: Print your own fantastic fantasy miniatures and busts from anywhere with a gigantic bundle of designs to fit your preferred fantasy motifs! Spice up your personal collection with 100+ fresh creations to style, customize, and collect that perfectly enhance any game or TTRPG adventure! Cause a ruckus with the 8‑pack Ruins Mega Pack, the 10‑piece Lumberyard Set, alongside menacing orcs, mythical phoenixes, human warriors, modular tavern sets, weaponry, and so much more. Plus, a portion of your purchase helps support Make‑A‑Wish!

expires_today.title: Caverns of Thracia & More by Goodman Games
expires_today.description: TTRPG greatness awaits with Caverns of Thracia!
expires_today.long_description: Calling all gallant TTRPG adventurers—we’ve teamed up with Goodman Games to curate the battle-ready Caverns of Thracia & More Bundle! A thousand-year-old dungeon mystery is waiting to be solved in Caverns of Thracia, and some say Death itself lingers within. Designed for 4-6 Dungeon Crawl Classics playable characters, the caverns are suitable as part of an existing campaign or kick off a new one. Pay what you want for Fifth Edition Fantasy #25–29 and Dungeon Crawl Classics #109–111, alongside goodies like the Goodman Games Yearbooks! Assemble 4–6 friends and roleplay epic quests within a mega‑dungeon of mystery today! Plus, your purchase helps support Make‑A‑Wish!

expires_today.title: Open World Essentials II
expires_today.description: Broaden your horizons with open world essentials
expires_today.long_description:
Don’t waste another second building assets from the ground up—choose from a massive selection of premium‑quality environments and set pieces like elite desert landscapes, medieval props, 4WD off‑roaders, and more with the Open World Essentials II Bundle. Unlock game‑ready open‑world assets like the Fantasy Dungeon Environment KitBash Set, Modular Water City Environment, Market Street Environment Kit, and others, perfect for expanding environmental storytelling and themed world design. Add style to your next project and help support Make‑A‑Wish with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before September 16th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Eat Your Protein! A Keto Cookbook Bundle for Carnivores by Page Street Publishing
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Learn how to cook healthy, nutritious, and delicious meals that cater to a variety of dietary restrictions with the Eat Your Protein: A Keto Cookbook Bundle for Carnivores by Page Street Publishing! This 25‑book collection is stacked with mouth‑watering recipes from critically acclaimed chefs and authors like Vivica Menegaz and Danielle Lima! Delete boring weeknight meals with recipes from hot titles like The Essential Carnivore Diet Cookbook and High‑Protein Macros Made Easy all for a price you choose. Add new flavors to your repertoire, and help support World Central Kitchen with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Crawling Through the Dungeons
expires_tomorrow.description: The depths are calling your name!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Treasures await deep below the surface with the Crawling Through the Dungeons Bundle! Experience a beloved classic remastered for a new generation of gamers with The Bard’s Tale Trilogy—featuring updated graphics and quality‑of‑life gameplay improvements! Or change the pace with CiniCross, the dark fantasy roguelite that mixes brain‑teasing nonogram puzzles and high‑level dungeon crawling! Grab your besties or make new ones within the depths of a challenging dungeon today, and help support Direct Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before March 30th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.long_description:

expires_tomorrow.title: Meshingun All-Stars
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Discover the Meshingun All-Stars Bundle, bringing together some of Meshingun’s biggest hits and best-selling Mega Packs in one massive collection. Get thousands of high-quality, production-ready assets covering horror, apocalyptic, abandoned, historical, Feudal Japan, World War themes, and more. Whether you’re building your next game, cinematic, or environment, this bundle gives you a huge range of assets to create more while saving serious production time. Professional License included.

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before September 24th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Mega Man: Recharged Collection
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Make way for a Mega Man Bundle unlike any other with the Recharged Collection! CAPCOM’s mascot hero was originally released in 1987 and has successfully reiterated its iconic action-platformer formula every decade to remain one of the most recognizable franchises in gaming. The rewarding gameplay loop of defeating powerful bosses and upgrading Mega Man’s arsenal by copying their special attacks remains deeply satisfying in 2026. Experience certified classics for the first time with the legacy titles or dive into the latest iterations like Mega Man X Dive OFFLINE all for a price you choose. Plus, your purchase helps the Raiden Science Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 30th, 2027

expires_tomorrow.title: CRPG Pack: Isometric Immersion
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Isometric games—that is, games that use a little projection trick to make the map look 3-D—give players a whole new way to move their characters around a world. Because we love celebrating unique perspectives, we’ve collected our favorite isometric games in one convenient bundle! Gather your crew, board your voidship, and travel through uncharted regions of space in Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader! Take on a world infested with demons and develop powers of mythic proportions in the Game of the Year Edition of Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous! Try to solve a murder while also trying to uncover your own past in the groundbreaking detective RPG Disco Elysium - The Final Cut! More fantastic adventures and unforgettable stories await you in this bundle of isometric classics, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Little Free Library with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 23rd, 2027

expires_tomorrow.title: Agile in Action: Scrum, Jira & AI Project Management
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Level up your project management and leadership skills with a comprehensive bundle of Scrum, Jira, and AI courses by Packt. Track the progress of your team, lead more effectively, and analyze valuable data quickly with courses like PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI‑ACP): Exploring Agile Project Management Essentials with PMI‑ACP and Beyond, Mastering Agile Scrum - From Basics to Advanced with Jira Projects: Master Agile, Scrum, and Jira for Modern Project Management Success, and so much more. Learn to confidently command your workflows and help support charity too!

expires_tomorrow.title: The Greg Bear Birthday Bundle by Open Road Media
expires_tomorrow.description: Celebrate the birthday of one of sci-fi’s masters
expires_tomorrow.long_description: The world of science fiction lost a titan when novelist Greg Bear passed away in 2022, but his books remain a perfect example of exactly what sci-fi was always meant to be. Author of over 50 books and co-founder of San Diego Comic Con, Bear made loving sci-fi into a career that spanned five decades. His work, which tested the limits of human (and non-human) consciousness and looked toward the far future and beyond, inspires and excites readers to this day. To celebrate what would have been Greg Bear’s 75th Birthday, in partnership with Open Road Media, we’ve collected a bundle of his best novels including award-winning classics like first contact thriller Eon, alien invasion drama The Forge of God, and post-apocalyptic space odyssey Anvil of Stars! Get a motherlode of some of the best sci-fi ever written for the price of your choosing, and support the Science Fiction & Fantasy Writers Association with your purchase!
